data.text: On 2026-10-09, the Nous Wave rebase moved configuration normalization before snapshot freeze. Rust typed owners and Core Zod owners supply complete validated values. Catalog metadata identity is separate from execution identity, and subset keys are sorted and deduplicated. A clean configuration instance verified that omitted video defaults and explicit complete defaults using the same operation ID return the same desired digest and revision. Active restart-scoped values remain unchanged until Core restarts, and read back as the complete normalized values after restart. Leaf configuration organization and reference graph validation are still pending.

On 2026-10-09, the Nous Wave reference consumer began isolating local state by stable Core instance ID plus consumer identity. CLI and MCP share an in-process command core. Maintained lock and atomic-write libraries protect only short local transactions; RPC and model calls are outside those locks. Each command freezes its chosen Subject, Session, WorkContext and input. Independent selection fields merge; conflicting scope updates preserve the returned business result and report STATE_UNSAVED. A clean Core/Kernel/PostgreSQL instance verified concurrent real CLI Session opening and MCP WorkContext creation into one shared state root, both selections surviving and remaining readable across both entry points and a Core restart. Real Codex/model continuity and Windows Portable continuation remain pending.
